title: What's Next? A Map of Advanced Paths

scenes.narration: Welcome to Nabulines Academy. You've built real apps, you've deployed them live, you've made them talk to APIs and databases. You're not a beginner anymore. So what's next? This lesson shows you the map — the different paths you can take from here — so you can pick the direction that excites you most.

First, understand this: you don't have to pick just one path. These aren't careers — they're skills you layer on top of each other. You might build a SaaS product that uses AI agents that run on your own infrastructure. Or you might automate your content creation while learning advanced backend patterns. The paths intersect. But it helps to have a map, so let's walk through the main directions.

visual.title: The Paths Aren't Exclusive
bullets: You can mix and layer them
Pick what excites you right now
This is a map, not a job title

scenes.narration: Path one: Product Builder. This is where you take what you've learned and build real products that people pay for. A SaaS app. A marketplace. A tool that solves a problem you've seen. You focus on user experience, payment flows, marketing, getting customers. You're not just coding — you're building a business. The tech is the same stack you already know, but now you're thinking about pricing, onboarding, retention, growth. This path is about turning code into money.

visual.title: Path 1: Product Builder
bullets: Build SaaS apps people pay for

scenes.narration: Path two: AI Agent Developer. You go deep on agents — systems that reason, plan, use tools, and act autonomously. You build agents that run workflows, scrape data, write code, manage infrastructure. You learn advanced prompting, tool-calling patterns, memory systems, multi-agent coordination. You might build an agent that monitors your app and fixes bugs, or an agent that generates content and publishes it, or an agent that handles customer support. This path is about making AI do real work without human intervention.

visual.title: Path 2: AI Agent Developer
bullets: Agents that reason and act autonomously
AI that does real work unsupervised

scenes.narration: Path three: Infrastructure Engineer. You learn how servers really work. You set up your own VPS, configure networking, manage databases, handle backups, set up monitoring, optimize performance. You move beyond serverless and understand the full stack — operating systems, containers, load balancers, CDNs. You can deploy anything anywhere and keep it running. This path is about control and understanding the machine.

visual.title: Path 3: Infrastructure Engineer
bullets: Manage your own servers and networks

scenes.narration: Path four: Content Creator and Automator. You use code to create and distribute content at scale. You build systems that generate videos, write articles, post to social media, manage communities. You learn video editing APIs, text-to-speech, image generation, scheduling systems. You might automate a YouTube channel, or build a newsletter that writes itself, or create a bot that runs a social account. This path is about using code to amplify your voice and reach.

visual.title: Path 4: Content Creator & Automator
bullets: Code that creates and distributes content

scenes.narration: Path five: Advanced Full-Stack Developer. You go deeper into the patterns and architectures that power large apps. You learn about caching strategies, database optimization, real-time systems, microservices, testing at scale. You understand how to structure code so it doesn't collapse under its own weight. You read other people's codebases and understand them. This path is about mastery of the craft itself.

visual.title: Path 5: Advanced Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Code that scales and stays clean

scenes.narration: So how do you choose? Here's my advice: pick the path that makes you want to start right now. Not the one that sounds impressive, not the one you think you should do — the one that makes you excited to open your editor today. You can always change direction. The skills transfer. But momentum matters more than the perfect choice. Pick something, start building, and let the work show you where to go next.

visual.title: How to Choose Your Path
bullets: Start building, adjust as you go

scenes.narration: Here's what you do next. Go to the exercise for this lesson. It asks you to choose a path and write down the very first concrete step you'll take. Not a vague goal — a specific action. Like: I'll build a SaaS landing page with a payment button. Or: I'll set up a VPS and deploy my portfolio there. Or: I'll build an agent that posts to Twitter every morning. One step. Write it down. Then do it. That's how you go from here to advanced. One step at a time, in a direction that matters to you.

visual.title: Your Next Action
bullets: Choose a path from this lesson
Not a goal — a specific action

scenes.narration: You've completed the core Nabulines Academy curriculum. You went from zero to deploying real apps, from no code to building with AI, from confused to capable. What you do next is up to you. Pick a path, take the first step, and keep building. I'll see you out there.

visual.subtitle: Pick a path. Take the first step. Keep building.

quiz.q: What's the most important factor in choosing your next path?
options: Which path excites you enough to start today
Which path pays the most money
Which path everyone else is doing

quiz.q: True or false: You must pick one path and stick with it forever.
options: False — the paths intersect and skills transfer

quiz.q: What should your first step be after choosing a path?
options: One specific action you can do today

quiz.q: Which path focuses on building systems that create and distribute content at scale?
What does the Product Builder path focus on beyond just coding?

exercise: Choose your next path from this lesson. Write down ONE specific action you'll take in the next 24 hours to start that path. Not a vague goal — a concrete step. Example: 'I'll deploy my portfolio to a VPS' or 'I'll build a landing page with a Stripe payment button' or 'I'll create an agent that posts a daily tip to Twitter.' Write it in a file called `my-next-step.md` in your projects folder. Then do it.
